description: The CTIO filter collection comprises the observatory pool of optical narrow-band and broad-band interference filters made available for instrumentation across CTIO telescopes.
short_description: CTIO observatory pool of optical narrow- and broad-band filters
facility_description: Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) is an astronomical observatory located on Cerro Tololo in Chile, operated by NSF NOIRLab.
notes: CTIO filter pool numerical curves are hosted on NOIRLab CTIO science pages without an explicit open redistribution grant. DetectorType of 3530_280, 3575_600, 3580_610, 3623_605, 4118_146, 4202_1050, 4203_1050, 4697_196, 5019_50, 5118_900, 5438_1026, 5488_1127, 6400_1450, 6410_1470, 8100_1550 set to photon, DetectorTypeSource inferred (2026-11-11), the label every served copy of the same curve now carries: CTIO publishes this curve as its own percent-transmission scan of the filter alone (e.g. 'C.T.I.O Filters 3530-280 u Strömgren … R. Gonzalez June 1994', columns 'Wl. %'; https://noirlab.edu/science/programs/ctio/filters/3x3-inch-and-4x4-inch-filters and the archived www.ctio.noao.edu/instruments/filters/FILTER-CURVES/). These 3x3- and 4x4-inch filters are the CTIO 0.9-m's, whose imager Tek2K 'is a 2K optical CCD imager'. NOIRLab's Hydra filter list, the source of the WIYN/Hydra copies, serves the WIYN Bench Spectrograph, also read by a CCD (https://www.wiyn.org/Instruments/wiynbench.html). A filter-only transmission used with a CCD counts photons. SVO's DetectorType is not used.
